title: RPG Maker U2U Software Launches for PC via Steam on January 28
content:
Gotcha Gotcha Games announced on Tuesday that its RPG Maker U2U software will launch for PC via Steam on January 28. The P2D (Perspective 2D) Map Editor Demo, which utilizes top-down mapping with spatial elevation, was originally scheduled to end on Tuesday, but it will now be available until the software's release. The company streamed a trailer:

The Steam page describes the software:

RPG MAKER U2U is the latest entry in the RPG Maker series of easy to use game development tools. With the addition of the new P2D system for adding depth and new light & shadow effects, create world of rich detail and immersion like never before!

RPG Maker WITH launched for PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 in February 2025. Both versions are cross-compatible with the Nintendo Switch release. NIS America released the software in the West for Switch in October 2024. The software launched for Switch in Japan in April 2024. The software allows creators to make games with others through "asset sharing."

Gotcha Gotcha Games released its RPG Maker Unite software in the Unity Asset Store in April 2023.

The software was previously scheduled to debut in April 2023 but the development company delayed it in order "to further improve the product's quality and stability." The software was originally slated for 2022, but was delayed to spring 2023 to optimize the software to ensure proper back-end coordination with the Unity Editor. The software launched first on the Unity Asset Store. The Steam version is slated for release later this year with a more optimized installation process.

Kadokawa released RPG Maker MZ ( RPG Tsukūru MZ ) on PC via Steam in August 2020.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog, McLaren Racing Collaborate on 3-Episode Animated Special
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) of the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise started streaming a teaser trailer for a new three-episode animated special titled Sonic the Hedgehog x McLaren Racing: Beyond Fast , on Monday.

The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds game also announced that it will add "Sonic (McLaren Racing)" as the second free update for Year Two on Tuesday.

McLaren Racing announced in 2025 a multi-year partnership with Sonic the Hedgehog franchise , making Sega the official gaming partner of McLaren Racing.

Sega began streaming the full Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond 35th anniversary short film on Friday.

An animation project for the Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game debuted in August 2025.

Netflix and Sega are producing a new children's animated series for the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise . The new show is targeted towards upper preschoolers.

The Sonic Prime animated series debuted on Netflix in December 2022 with one 40-minute episode and seven 20-minute episodes. Netflix streamed the third season in January 2024.

The live-action Sonic the Hedgehog 4 film is scheduled for a March 19, 2027 release. The franchise is also receiving a fifth film in 2028.

title: Reading Our Way to a Happy New World Manga Listed to End With 3rd Volume
content:
Online retailers are listing the third compiled book volume of Chac Choa 's Reading Our Way to a Happy New World ( Yomutabi ni Shiawase o! ) manga as the final volume for the series. The third volume ships on January 12.

Manga UP! Global publishes the series in English and describes the story:

In this post-apocalyptic world, the perfect chronicles of human history... are manga?! This is the story of Mekuri and Kiyoshi. They're on a journey to collect and decipher all the manga they can, all while living out a happy life!

Chac Choa launched the series in Square Enix 's Shonen Gangan magazine in June 2025. Square Enix 's Manga UP! platform also publishes the series.

Square Enix shipped the first compiled book volume on January 9.

title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes Deserves an Official English Release
content:
Super Dragon Ball Heroes released in the summer of 2018 and ran through August of 2024, and yet, it remains the only full series in the franchise to not get an official English release. In fairness to Toei Animation, it is a non-canon promotional anime, so it’s not even a requirement for the official timeline. However, they built an entire card game and toy line that are available for purchase in the United States. The ardent fans are going to find ways to watch, but for mass consumption a legal release is needed. Especially an English dub.

The franchise completely embraced the multiverse concept with Dragon Ball Super , and this property fits right into that. It should get the opportunity to introduce its concept. The argument for and against probably pertains to the fact that it’s just an imaginary world inside of Dragon Ball . When Dragon Ball GT and other Dragon Ball movies that are now non-canon were released , they weren’t considered unofficial at the time. Super Dragon Ball Heroes is already known as non-canon, so maybe it’s not getting the release it deserves. The quick plot is mostly a vessel to move the show forward and into the mammoth-level fights, but that’s what it was created for.

Super Dragon Ball Heroes Have a Ton of Characters Needing a Dub Debut

Some powerful fighters made their debut in the Super Dragon Ball Heroes, but they’ve yet to get introduced to the majority of the fans who only know about the official English releases. The Xenoverse versions of Universe 7’s Saiyan fighters are waiting for their official English debut. Xeno Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Trunks, Bardock and more are all Time Patrollers that displayed insane levels of power in the project while villains like the Evil Saiyan Cumber, Demigra and Fu proved to be elite foes to add to the franchise’s roster.

Multiple characters in the series boast plenty of power, but also a myriad of storylines that differ from the canon. Xeno Bardock’s story is interesting because we get to see what Goku’s father would’ve achieved had he never been destroyed by Frieza while his son Raditz also gets a facelift and becomes a higher level Saiyan warrior. Cumber’s first appearance in the promotional anime also gave fans a chance to see two of the biggest Saiyans in the multiverse go toe-to-toe , and that’s not something fans can see anywhere else.

A New Dub Release Would Help Fans Wait A Little Longer

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus released just last month, but the remake is just a recut version of the original. Much Like Dragon Ball Z Kai , it gives something to get the fans by for a bit, but it’s not new content. Dragon Ball Daima has been out for more than two years, but is the most recent brand new release. Super Dragon Ball Heroes getting an English dub release isn’t necessarily new content either, but it’s more significant than a reformatting of a show everyone has already seen.

Fan dubs did their best to give Super Dragon Ball Heroes an English release, but it didn’t have the official voice actors. The promotional series also doesn’t have an official streaming platform either. It’s not on Crunchyroll, Netflix, Hulu or any of the major platforms. Fans had to seek it out through not necessarily the most legal means, and that ultimately made it feel that much cheaper. Toei treated worse content with more respect. It’s time to give the show a broader release with an English dub. Do you think Super Dragon Ball Heroes deserves an official English release? Let us know in the comments.

title: Yametai! ~Anata no Reset, Daikō Shimasu~ Manga Ends
content:
Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app published the second and last part of the final chapter of Jun Esaka and artist Kine Usuto 's Yametai! ~Anata no Reset, Daikō Shimasu~ (I Want to Quit! ~I'll Reset for You~) manga on Sunday.

The corporate drama manga centers on a resignation agent who will either open up freedom or a new hell to their clients.

Esaka and Usuto launched the series on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app on January 11. Shogakukan shipped the first compiled book volume on May 19, and will ship the second and final volume on December 17.

Esaka's novel adaptation of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga shipped in Japan in November 2025.

Shueisha published Esaka's Naruto: Sasuke's Story--The Uchiha and the Heavenly Stardust novel in 2019. Viz Media published the novel in English in 2022.

Esaka and artist Sayaka Suwa 's One Piece: Heroines light novel series was first serialized in issues of the One Piece Magazine starting in 2019, before Shueisha published the first compiled novel in Japan in June 2021. Shueisha published the second novel volume titled One Piece novel HEROINES [Colorful] in March 2024. Viz Media published the second volume on July 22. The One Piece: Heroines anime premiered on July 5 on Fuji TV with episode: NAMI. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.

title: Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai no Kū Anime Gets Light Novel
content:
The story is set in the Genji era, when the Battle Spirits card game takes the city of Edo by storm. The game uses two cards: Eternal Cards, which only samurai are permitted to use, and Standard Cards, which anyone can use. The 11-year-old Kū Bashin encounters a mysterious card and begins his journey.

The anime premiered on October 6 on Tokyo MX and other channels. Crunchyroll is streaming the series.

Bandai launched its original Battle Spirits trading card game in 2008. In the game, cards represent dragons, demons, birds, insects, and other spirits that the players can control in battles. Bandai imported the game to the United States in 2009. Battle Spirits: Connected Battlers , the latest video game in the franchise, launched for PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch in April 2022.

The franchise launched the 50-episode Battle Spirits: Shōnen Toppa Bashin anime series in September 2008. A new television anime series aired almost every year afterwards until 2016-2017's Battle Spirits Double Drive .

A three-episode net anime series titled Battle Spirits: Saga Brave then premiered in June 2019. Battle Spirits: Kakumei no Galett launched in August 2020. Battle Spirits: Mirage , the most recent anime in the franchise, premiered online in October 2021.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Will Reveal More of Korra’s Fate in Season 2
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens began to scratch the surface of what led Korra to destroying the world with the cataclysm, and one of the producers behind the series has confirmed that fans will see more of Korra and what led to this post-apocalyptic event in the second season. Avatar: Seven Havens is quickly speeding our way with a planned release with Paramount+ next Spring , and that’s great because there are some big mysteries that fans are hoping to get to the bottom of as soon as possible.

Avatar: Seven Havens is now in the works on returning for Season 2, and executive producer Sehaj Sethi recently took part in a Reddit AMA and answered all sorts of fan questions about the now in the works season. With Korra first seen in the vision that Pavi and Nisha had about the past , Sethi confirmed that fans will see even more of Korra in the new season and ultimately find out more of what led Korra to seemingly to enact the cataclysm.

Avatar: Seven Havens Producer Teases More of Korra in Season 2

When asked about some of the other characters’ backstories fans might get to see in the coming season, Sethi confirmed that there are indeed going to be more of them on the way, “Throughout the entire series we try to take peeks into virtually all of our characters’ pasts,” Sethi began before revealing that we’ll see much more of Korra , “Book Two will definitely share more about Korra, and what happened during the Cataclysm.” This is also going to open up the series to potentially even more updates about fan-favorite characters too.

Avatar: Seven Havens takes place over 200 years following The Legend of Korra , and because of that Sethi explains that the team, “didn’t make it a priority to try and focus on descendents from characters of the previous series,” because of such a wide time gap between the shows. But it’s not impossible to get an update, however, as Sethi further teases fans “will hear about a few of them in flashbacks!” Which means this coming season is going to be very important to putting together the rest of this puzzle for Korra’s fate after her series.

What Does This Mean for Korra’s Future in Avatar: Seven Havens ?

In a recent interview with IGN, Sethi also confirmed that more of Korra and Asami’s future after The Legend of Korra will be seen in Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2, with Asami confirmed long dead by the time of the new series. They had been seen in a “mover” revealing that Korra and Asami potentially got married following the end of that series. But with more of their future needing to be revealed in the coming season, and that likely leading to a gap that gets Korra to the point of the cataclysm, there’s a long amount of time needing to be accounted for.

As Pavi began to tap into the power of her chakras, she also seemed to get more of a connection to Korra in the process. It’s been confirmed that Pavi has yet to reconnect to the Avatar Cycle, but it’s still possible for that connection to be reformed once more. Especially if there might be future series with future Avatars to explore in the coming years. But what are you hoping to see from Korra in Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ future? Let us know all of your thoughts about in the comments.

HT – Reddit

title: HIDIVE Streams Giant Ojosama TV Anime This Winter; Screens N. American Premiere at Anime Frontier on December 4
content:
HIDIVE announced on Tuesday that it will stream the television anime of Nikumura Q 's Giant Ojō-sama (Giant Young Lady) manga for the winter 2027 season in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand. The company will screen the North American premiere at this year's Anime Frontier event in Fort Worth, TX on December 4. HIDIVE streamed an English-subtitled trailer:

The anime stars:

• Yū Serizawa as Oriko Fujido

• Junya Enoki as Dr. Sebastian

• Risa Imayanagi as Madoka Ito

• Rina Kawaguchi as Stella

Hiroshi Ikehata ( WITCH WATCH ) is directing the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Katsuya Oshima is serving as assistant director. Hajime Mitsuda ( Food for the Soul ) is the character designer and chief animation director. Yū Satō ( Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! ) is handling the series composition and script. Yūsuke Shirato ( Rumble Garanndoll ), Kijibato , and Aira ( Dream Monster ) are composing the music.

The additional staff includes:

• Art Design: Takashi Hiruma

• Art Director: Akira Itō (StudioARA)

• Color Setting: Misako Akama

• Photography: Masashi Kamiki (Studio Myu), Yōhei Konishi (Studio Twinkle)

• Editing: Akinori Mishima

• Animation Producer: Miki Kaneko

The story centers around Oriko Fujidō, the scion of an ultra-wealthy family who finds herself growing to gigantic proportions. She had received an entire town as a present on her fourth birthday, but one day, a giant invader attacks her town. Her butler Sebastian offers her a drink that transforms her into a giant, so she strives to protect her town — but just might end up destroying it, throwing the denizens' lives into chaos.

Nikumura Q has been serializing the Giant Ojō-sama manga since July 2020 on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry service. Shogakukan published the manga's 13th compiled book volume on September 11. The manga was nominated by for best web manga in the eighth "Next Manga Awards" (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō) in 2022, and it ranked #5 in AnimeJapan's sixth "Most Wanted Anime Adaptation" poll the following year.

title: One Year Later, My Dress-Up Darling Still Leaves Fans Hanging With No Season 3
content:
My Dress-Up Darling wrapped up its second season with an ending that seemed like it was ending the anime overall, and a little over a year later fans have still been left hanging with their hopes of a potential third season ever happening. The anime adaptation for Shinichi Fukuda’s original manga series breathed an entirely new kind of life into the franchise. Because while the manga was on the way out, the anime brought a whole new wave of fans to the series thanks to its take on Marin Kitagawa .

My Dress-Up Darling ended its second season run last year, but there was still quite a bit of the manga’s story left to adapt . This had fans wondering whether or not the series would return for a possible third season, but unfortunately a year later that has yet to be revealed. It seems even further off than that because not only did the second season have an original ending, but those behind the production team touted how there were no plans at the time either.

Will My Dress-Up Darling Ever Get a Season 3?

My Dress-Up Darling Season 2 wrapped up its run with an original scene not seen in Shinichi Fukuda’s original manga . Following the end of the group cosplay seen with the Coffin Arc, Marin had fully realized her feelings and accepted that she really was in love with Gojo. She had planned to confess, but decided at the end of the season to instead ask for a selfie together with him as the series came to an end. Which also seemed to be set up to be a potential original anime finale as the two characters were closer than ever.

Producer behind the series, Shota Umehara, had revealed at the time that he would like to pursue a future for the series, but at the time production was a “blank slate” with nothing planned. This not only meant that no potential third season had been decided at the time, but also meant that any continuation would be much further off than fans would likely hope for. Now that we’re a year out from the second season, it likely means an even longer wait for a continuation. If one happens at all, anyway. But there’s still material left to adapt if the team wanted.

How My Dress-Up Darling’ s Anime Could Return

My Dress-Up Darling still has about two arcs of the manga left for a potential anime future with about 30 or so chapters that could be tackled in a third season. This would be a little over the 20 or so chapters adapted with the second season , and that gives plenty of runway for an anime adaptation. There’s also a potential to bring the franchise back with a finale movie given that it’s a route that many franchises go these days with their respective finale, but it would miss out on all the potential material left on the cutting room floor in that way.

A full third season is really the only way to bring My Dress-Up Darling back, but it’s likely going to be quite a while before that happens. CloverWorks has been very busy with all sorts of other projects now at various stages of development, and despite Marin’s popularity , finishing off the anime likely isn’t at the top of any list at the moment. Given that some franchises have had fans waiting a decade in between potential season before returning, all fans can do right now is wait.

In the meantime, you can catch up with My Dress-Up Darling now streaming with Crunchyroll. Would you want to see it come back with a third season or even a movie someday? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Shonen Jump Creator Breaks Silence on Ending Their Series After 5 Years & Teases Epilogue
content:
A major Shonen Jump series has come to an end after five years with its final chapter released this past weekend, and the creator behind it all has broken their silence on the grand finale with a tease of some new materials for after the series came to an end. The year has already seen a number of the late 2010s-early 2020s generation of titles end their respective stories , and now Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch can be counted among them with the release of its own final chapter.

Witch Watch officially ended its run with Shonen Jump after five years of serialization this past weekend , and Shinohara took to social media to share a special goodbye message with fans to celebrate the grand finale. Noting how they felt like this was the right time to end the series (despite the fact it felt like it could go on for much longer), Shinohara teases that the final volume release of the series will include some special epilogue art set after the grand finale.

Witch Watch Creator Says Goodbye to Fans After 5 Years

Witch Watch officially came to an end with the release of Chapter 270 of the series right after its final battle , and Shinohara began their goodbye message by apologizing to those fans who had hoped to see more of the wacky daily life adventures, “Thank you so much to everyone who read it! I’m sorry to those who thought I’d return to the everyday-life chapters.” But as the creator explained, it would have been hard to keep track of when to actually end the series in that case, “Once I finished writing the climax, I wanted to wrap things up quickly, and I was afraid that once I returned to everyday life, I’d get so caught up in it that I’d lose track of when to end it, so I decided to bring the story to a close here.”

But while Witch Watch seemed like it could have been built to run forever, Shinohara noted how it was time to move on, “Honestly, I could keep drawing a manga like Witch Watch forever if I wanted to, so that’s exactly why I feel I need to bring it to a close at some point and move on to my next challenge.” But thankfully, the creator has also teased there will be some final pages for the characters in the final volume releases, “I plan to draw lots of bonus pages for the final volume, including scenes of the characters’ everyday lives after the story ends, so please be sure to pick it up.”

What’s Next for Witch Watch ?

With Witch Watch creator Kenta Shinohara confirming that there will be some additional pages featuring more of the characters after the grand finale, it’s a hope that fans will get some of the closure they had been hoping to see that was absent from the final chapter. With it jumping years into the future, yet still teasing all of the group would still be hanging out together, fans were hoping to just see more of the wacky adventures that drew them to the series in the first place.

But this also isn’t the end of the Witch Watch franchise as it has now been confirmed that Season 2 of the anime is now in the works for a release in 2027. No concrete release date has been announced for it just yet, but there’s plenty to look forward to even if the manga has come to an end. How do you feel about Witch Watch ‘s ending? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.
